reconstruction_issues: Table appeals uses 167.1 hours versus 33*5=165; possibly unrounded 1% of renewals, not explicitly exposed.
Recordkeeping prose says 8208 hours but table 8503.5. Item15 count 102400 versus table102042.
KSMS O&M 1.2m prose versus1.6m table. Three-year total not 3*annual total.
